name: property-deep-dive
description: Pre-purchase property due diligence across 126 countries — tax, risks, rental yield, visa, mortgage, building permits, schools, connectivity and 33 more sections per address. Detects the country from an address or listing URL, loads that country's playbook, and outputs a structured Markdown brief sourced to primary government registries with every figure dated and confidence-labelled.

interface.shortDescription: Pre-purchase property due diligence across 126 countries
interface.longDescription: Drop in any address or listing URL: the skill detects the country, loads the local playbook, runs the sections you ask for, and returns a structured brief. Sources are primary government registries rather than aggregators; every figure is dated and every section carries a confidence band that decays without re-verification.
